description: Manual test cases for the A Constellation MVP.

cases.name: Valid seed data
cases.expected: All six memories load and render.

cases.name: Unknown connection
cases.expected: Validation fails with a readable error.

cases.name: Missing dates
cases.expected: Memory card renders a neutral date message; no recent pulse.

cases.name: Known date within last seven calendar days
cases.expected: Memory receives a subtle recent pulse.

cases.name: Drag sky
cases.expected: Pointer movement translates the map without selecting a star.

cases.name: Select star
cases.expected: Memory card opens with title, text, branch, and related memories.

cases.name: Keyboard select
cases.expected: Enter and Space open a focused star.

cases.name: Reduced motion
cases.expected: CSS animations are reduced for users requesting reduced motion.
